items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: [(boilerplate)] Joanne was interviewed in New York City on January 10, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

ctx.x: Joanne was interviewed in New York City on January 10, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming in New York City at the International Association of Jazz Educators. And I’m very pleased to have Joanne Brackeen here. And welcome and thank you very much for coming.
